title: Another Word for Happy: Stop Saying "Very Happy" (10 Words)
description:
Another word for happy: stop saying "very happy" and use one of these 10 better English words instead. You get five words for how you feel about good news and five words for happy people and happy times. Every word comes with a picture, a clear meaning and an example sentence. After each set of five words, you test yourself with a quick quiz and practise speaking by repeating the example sentences out loud after me.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:10 Good news
1:08 Speaking practice: good news
1:41 Happy people and times
2:40 Speaking practice: happy people and times
3:21 Your turn

The 10 words
Good news: thrilled, delighted, overjoyed, ecstatic, elated
Happy people and times: joyful, radiant, jubilant, blissful, euphoric

Which word will you use next time? Write it in the comments.

Find another word for any word on anotherwordfor.net
